pages.text: Activated Fractionator: splits activated crystal in two —$(li)Activated component: feeds the Fusion Fuel Aggregator, heading toward plasma$(li)Exhausted crystal: waste, but don't toss it; the Item Reconstructor loves it$(br)One process, two destinies — the akaishi 'indecision ender'.
Plasma Pipe: the third transport family, and it only accepts plasma.$(br)Other liquids want a ride? Not a chance. Aloof, faithful, never mixes flavors.
Plasma Fuel Tank: the exclusive mansion for plasma, storing nothing but plasma.$(br)With pipes and the aggregator, plasma flows from production to filling without spilling a single drop.
Exhausted Fuel Barrel: the dedicated 'hazardous waste bin' for spent fuel.$(br)Whether your reactor stays in one piece is half cooling, half remembering to dump the waste in here.
